fact_pattern.text: By a Final Decree dated 5th May 2018 entered in partition case bearing No 3535/P of the District Court of Nugegoda, Ajith Silva was allotted all that allotment of Land marked Lot 2 depicted in Plan No 1616 dated 2nd March 2010 made by A C Perera Licensed Surveyor of the land called Kahatagahawatte bearing assessment No 12 Temple Road, Nugegoda containing in extent 15 perches. Ajith Silva upon Deed of Gift No 515 dated 10th December 2018 attested by PC Nonis Notary Public gifted the said Lot 2 depicted in said Plan No 1616 to Prabash Silva who is the elder son of Ajith subject to life interest of the Donor and also subject to the condition that Prabash shall not sell, mortgage or otherwise deal with the land but enjoy the produce thereof during his lifetime and that on the death of Prabash the property shall devolve free of all conditions to Subash who is the younger son of Ajith Silva. Ajith had three children namely Prabash, Subash and Shehani by his second marriage to Yamuna. Ajith had another daughter named Kushani from his first marriage to Sumana. Ajith Silva died intestate on 2nd March 2019 and Prabash Silva died intestate on 2nd June 2019 by the Covid 19 Pandemic. Prabash had two daughters namely Sunali and Bimali by his first wife Sheela and two sons namely Brian and Rian by his second wife Linda. Sheela died on 5th August 2019 intestate. Brian married Sara and thereafter died by an accident on 25th September 2021 without having children. Sonali died on 10th October 2023 unmarried and issueless.
